race.comment: PORTLAND ROSE (13) was outclassed on debut in the Blue Diamond Prelude then put away. Returned in a maiden at Echuca and just found one better in Presscode. Fitter and expected to go close again. MISS NAVRATILOVA (7) resumed her second campaign with a fast finishing sixth at Wangaratta off a long spell. Will strip much fitter and drawn for a soft run with cover. With even luck looks tough to stop again. SWIFT ACTION (14) is a first starter by St Mark's Basilica out of Bird Inthe Heather. Has had plenty of education and looks all set to run well. TYRANT REX (11) is a gelding by Wild Ruler on debut. Won a Cranbourne jump-out on August 17. Winning chance.
